selected_script.angle: Absurd glamorous grandmother in an oversized metallic silver space astronaut suit enters the kitchen holding the UFORU cover to rescue soggy, oil-separated leftover chili.
selected_script.hook: Extreme close-up of oily red chili grease aggressively snapping and spitting onto the paper towel draped over a bowl in a microwave.
scene_order: 1.5-3s: absurd adult family rescuer with product

script_record.pain_point: Greasy chili splatter destroying microwave interior while paper towels fail and absorb all sauce moisture
script_record.conflict_hook: Glamorous astronaut grandmother swoops in with clear UFORU steam cover
script_record.product_solution: Water added to side reservoir, cover placed over plate, steam locks in moisture while stopping splatters

timeline.scene: Extreme close-up of red chili grease snapping and bursting through a flimsy paper towel inside a microwave.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: An absurd grandmother in a shiny silver space suit enters holding the transparent UFORU cover and says 'No more splatter!'
Pouring a splash of water into the clear side reservoir and placing the dome over the bowl on the turntable.
Clear dome rotating smoothly inside microwave, light condensation forming while food stays juicy and splatter-free.
Pouring excess condensed water neatly out of the small front drainage channel outlet into the sink.
Lifting the cover using the olive-green arched handle to reveal perfectly heated, fresh hot chili.
Product sitting neatly on kitchen counter next to clean microwave. Text overlay: Make your kitchen mess-free.

script_record.cta: A simple upgrade for everyday use.
